# Azury Labs

> Azury Labs LLC is the United States entity of an applied-AI and software
> technology group operating across the United States, Mexico, and Colombia
> (with sister company Iruz Labs SAS serving Mexico and Colombia). It builds
> eight proprietary product lines—including real-time AI agents, an Agentic
> Relationship Management (ARM) sales operating system, and autonomous software
> engineering—alongside custom software solutions.

For full product specs, ARM vs. CRM comparison, and FAQ answers, see
[llms-full.txt](https://azurylabs.online/llms-full.txt).

## Products

- **Iruz Atenea** — Platform to create AI agents that handle messages and voice
  in real time, know the business, connect to its systems, and execute real
  processes. https://atenea.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Lindex** — Autonomous software engineering harness. Coordinates AI
  agents from ticket to code, tests, and a deployed preview, with isolated
  execution, full traceability, and per-task budget control. Integrates with
  Linear, Jira, GitHub, GitLab, and Cloudflare Pages. https://lindex.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Sales OS** — Omnichannel Agentic Relationship Management (ARM) sales
  operating system. Goes beyond a traditional CRM by uniting channels,
  autonomous AI agents, and human teams to engage, qualify, follow up, and
  advance every opportunity. https://crm.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Mi Negocio** — Business management: customers, quotes, orders, and
  follow-up in one simple operation. https://minegocio.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz CIEE** — Data and research: AI-driven surveys, opinion studies, and
  political or market polling. https://ciee.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Systems** — Custom software development, technology consulting, and
  guided implementation. https://systems.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Connect** — The official WhatsApp Business API for businesses and
  applications, without Meta's technical complexity. Handles credentials,
  webhooks, and message statuses. Upcoming channels: Instagram, Messenger, SMS,
  RCS, and voice. https://connect.iruzlabs.com
- **Iruz Tracking System** — Product and campaign analytics that measures every
  step of the customer journey, from first contact to sale, using trackable
  links and QR codes. https://go.iruzlabs.com/+

## Trust, Alliances & Global Technology Programs

Azury Labs LLC is backed by an active global ecosystem of leading AI, cloud, and messaging technology programs, providing enterprise-grade infrastructure, reliability, and security:

- **NVIDIA Inception** — Official program member
- **Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program** — Member (and Commercial Marketplace Publisher)
- **AWS for Startups** — Active cloud infrastructure program
- **Meta Tech Provider & WhatsApp Business Partner** — Official messaging ecosystem
- **ElevenLabs Startup Grants** — Real-time conversational voice AI partner
